tool_schemas.name: search_google_scholar_key_words
tool_schemas.description: Runs a Google Scholar keyword search for the provided query and returns up to num_results normalized publication records (e.g., title/authors/venue/year/citations/link) from the persisted results for that query. Results are returned as a single list (no paging tokens); if fewer matches are available, fewer items are returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is empty/invalid or num_results is not a positive integer, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to run searches, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if rate limits are hit, and UPSTREAM_ERROR if Scholar scraping/search fails or is blocked.

tool_schemas.name: search_google_scholar_advanced
tool_schemas.description: Runs an advanced Google Scholar search using query plus optional author and year_range filters, and returns up to num_results normalized publication records persisted for that exact filter set. Results are returned as a single list (no paging tokens); year_range must be a valid range (start/end), and filters may reduce the list to fewer than num_results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed inputs (empty query, invalid year_range shape/order, or non-positive num_results), UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks access, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate-limited, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the upstream Scholar request cannot be completed.

tool_schemas.name: get_author_info
tool_schemas.description: Resolves an author by name, stores/refreshes the author profile and associated publication list for faster follow-up queries, and returns the normalized author profile and publications currently on record. If multiple candidates match, the service returns the best-resolved profile it can based on its lookup workflow rather than a paged disambiguation list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if author_name is empty/invalid, NOT_FOUND if no author profile can be resolved for the provided name, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to perform author lookups, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if rate limits prevent the lookup/refresh.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_api_key
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling API key identity and current entitlement state, including status, configured limits, and current-day usage. Refuses requests authenticated with a missing/invalid key, or with a key in status other than active.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

tool_schemas.name: list_search_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists persisted search requests created under the calling API key, newest first. Supports filtering by status and tool_name and returns a paginated slice. Refuses requests authenticated with a missing/invalid key, a non-active key, or when the key is over its daily quota.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

status.description: Filter by search request lifecycle status.

tool_name.description: Filter by the tool that created the request.

query_contains.description: Optional substring match on the original query string.

author_contains.description: Optional substring match on the original author filter (advanced searches only).

requested_after.description: Only return requests with requested_at >= this timestamp (RFC 3339).

requested_before.description: Only return requests with requested_at <= this timestamp (RFC 3339).

page_size.description: Maximum number of items to return.

page_token.description: Opaque cursor returned from a previous call to fetch the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_search_request
tool_schemas.description: Fetches one persisted search request by id, including its current status and summary counts. Refuses if the request does not exist, is not owned by the calling API key, or the API key is missing/invalid or not active.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

search_request_id.description: Primary id of the search_requests record to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: list_search_results
tool_schemas.description: Lists persisted results for a given search_request_id, ordered by rank ascending. Returns normalized publication fields alongside per-result metadata (rank, snippet, result_type). Refuses if the request does not exist, is not owned by the calling API key, or the API key is missing/invalid or not active.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

search_request_id.description: Primary id of the search_requests record whose results should be listed.

page_size.description: Maximum number of results to return.

page_token.description: Opaque cursor returned from a previous call to fetch the next page.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_search_request
tool_schemas.description: Cancels an in-flight search request owned by the calling API key by transitioning its status to cancelled. Only requests in status queued or running can be cancelled; completed requests are refused. Returns the updated search request record.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

search_request_id.description: Primary id of the search_requests record to cancel.

reason.description: Optional human-readable cancellation reason stored for diagnostics.

tool_schemas.name: refresh_author_profile
tool_schemas.description: Forces a re-fetch of an author profile by id and refreshes its publication list, updating lifecycle status per fetch outcome (active/not_found/blocked) and marking previously active profiles stale/active as appropriate. Returns the updated normalized author profile and its publications on record. Refuses if the profile id does not exist, or if the API key is missing/invalid, not active, or over quota.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

author_profile_id.description: Primary id of the author_profiles record to refresh.

force.description: If true, refresh even if last_fetched_at is recent; if false, the service may short-circuit using cached data.

metadata.name: Google Scholar Search Server
metadata.description: This backend powers a Google Scholar search server that accepts keyword and advanced (author/year-range) queries, executes scraping/search jobs, and persists normalized publication results.
